reason: Cross-national and individual-level studies do not identify a portable intervention on aggregate cultural tightness.
Insult is randomized, region/cultural norm is not; measured reactions are individual outcomes rather than shared obligation.
Manipulations bundle synchrony, arousal, music or exertion and measure social outcomes, not the cultural Driver.
Experiments measure individual evaluation/endorsement; no shared culture-level norm change or stable aggregation is identified.
